The dominant signal is the AIP paper's 'all ~2,000 MCP servers lacked authentication' finding plus the AgentRFC + Aegis + Runtime-Governance cohort that defines an emerging 'agent-protocol governance' axis. sectors.name: Agents & infrastructure
sectors.description: Agent-protocol governance crystallises as a Sunday subtheme — AIP scans ~2,000 MCP servers and finds zero authentication; AgentRFC delivers the first systematic security framework for MCP / A2A / ANP / ACP; Aegis + Runtime-Governance papers formalise cryptographic / path-evaluated runtime enforcement. Sergey Gromov's Palantir AIP teardown is the production-grade enterprise counterpart to LangGraph patterns. Slack MCP GA pre-stage 31 Mar + ServiceNow Action Fabric pre-stage 2 April still working downstream.

sectors.name: Methods & research
sectors.description: Sunday quiet — DyMoE (CVPR 2026, drift-aware token assignment for continual VLM learning) + MIT Han Lab FourOverSix (adaptive block-scaled NVFP4 data types) target the engineering layer below frontier deployment — both push the inference-cost story Jensen Huang opened GTC with. CRAFT contrastive reasoning alignment + WALAR translation reward-hacking mitigation extend the post-training thread.

sectors.name: Models & capabilities
sectors.description: Carry day — OpenAI 'Spud' pretraining-complete signal continues to circulate via The Neuron weekend digest (later launches as GPT-5.5 on 23 April). xAI founder-exodus story carries from Saturday. Mythos international pickup wave settles back; slow EMA still climbing while fast EMA drops on light Sunday volume.

sectors.name: Governance & market
sectors.description: Most policy-relevant Sunday of the window — Mind the Gap (statutes conflate model capability with system architecture, miss control points: prompts/API permissions/sandboxing) is direct ammunition for the EU-AI-Act-readiness debate. Aegis + Runtime-Governance + Onto-Relational-Sophic round out the runtime-governance cohort. Anthropic peak-hour Claude Code throttling + 7 April livestream cadence carry as compute-supply-meets-product-comms signal.
